The attachment guides only Adult A's visible adult appearance: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, calm neutral expression, steady object-directed gaze, understated makeup, and a dark wrap-style upper garment beneath an open transparent rain cape. Adult B stands alone on the right platform as receiver, visibly distinct through close-cropped pale blond hair, clear round protective glasses, a bright saffron waterproof coat, and slate trousers. At first glance, two unmistakably adult actors remain separately legible on separate granite platforms, with open air, pale columns, and black water separating their complete heads, torsos, arms, and silhouettes. At this precise moment, the giver's hand actively releases the same object as Adult A's right fingertips open from the bail; Adult A's other hand is fully visible, open, empty, and resting beside the hip. Simultaneously, the receiver's hand aligns to accept it with a visible response as Adult B grips the bail and supports the base; Adult B's left fingers close firmly around the far-right bail while the right palm cups the complete underside. Both adults look at the lantern, and the giver's loosening grip plus the receiver's two-point support make the unfinished left-to-right transfer immediately readable. Maintain clean anatomy so each hand remains anatomically owned and non-conflicting with both wrists fully visible against contrasting backgrounds. Place Adult A in the left third, Adult B in the right third, and every contact point in the clear center third. Preserve both heads, torsos, elbows, wrists, palms, fingers, the complete lantern, and both nearest platform edges in sharp focus. Cool cyan side light separates the outer silhouettes; the lantern is the sole dominant warm amber center and reveals the inner forearms, fingertips, bail, and base. Pale tile, dark recesses, amber glow, and black water create tonal separation around every hand. Render natural anatomy, coherent reflections, realistic adult skin and wet-tile texture, subtle filmic contrast, preserved shadow detail, and fine high-ISO grain as a believable real photograph.
